objective: Build the first end-to-end Banco Santo Andre card and wallet experience with multi-tenant users, admin controls, purchases, installments, invoices and interest modeling
constraints: Original Banco Santo Andre brand with no third-party source code, branding or proprietary interface copying
Every feature ships with automated tests
No commit, push or deployment without an explicit request
success_criteria: Backend card and wallet slice compiles and is executable
PostgreSQL schema is versioned with Flyway
REST API is documented with OpenAPI
Unit and integration tests cover the delivered behavior
Docker Compose describes PostgreSQL, Redis and Kafka
Kubernetes manifests deploy the service without embedded secrets
Architecture provides explicit seams for authorization and ledger services
Angular interface provides login, customer dashboard, purchase simulation and admin dashboard
Original Banco Santo Andre logo is integrated
Interest and installment rules are deterministic, decimal-safe and tested
